Trasu vidíte jen vy, fyzioterapeut ani t: Only you can see the route; your physio and coach cannot.
U rovnoměrného běhu od hodiny: kolik ryc: For a steady run of an hour or more: how much speed (adjusted to flat ground) each heartbeat bought in the second half against the first, leaving out the first 10 minutes. The smaller the drift, the better your body holds the pace without the heart rate creeping up. In marathon runners a smaller drift went with faster times (Smyth 2022). The 5 % line is a coaching convention. Heat and fluid loss raise heart rate even without fatigue.
Ve druhé polovině stejné tempo stálo víc: In the second half the same pace cost more heartbeats ({0} → {1} bpm). {2}

Týden se počítá, když jste trénovali, zá: A week counts when you trained, the load never went over the threshold of 25 on any day, and the Runner's must-have strength sessions were done as the programme asks (twice a week, once in its lighter weeks). Illness, pain or a week without training doesn't break the run, it just doesn't count: nobody should train ill or through pain to keep a run going. Kilometres and pace don't count here.
Za návyky, které chrání před zraněním. Z: For the habits that protect you from injury. A milestone, once earned, stays yours.

24 tréninků programu odolnosti, tedy 12: 24 sessions of the durability programme: 12 weeks, two a week.
